rationale: Motor vehicle collision causing damage to the policyholder's vehicle; clearly covered under the auto policy with comprehensive collision damage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at approximately 8:15am by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. Vehicle is totaled with severe trunk/back-seat damage. Claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information.

case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info included
